summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers to delegate to them. Updated the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32, renamed output_path to output_dir in two examples and the sliding-window integration test, added the four new test files, updated the classification handler test, and added data docs entries. Nothing was run: per instructions, verification was by reading only, plus shell checks for line length, whitespace, file endings, and continuation indents. Test execution and the ignite 0.3.0 registration of the bound _finalize hook still need to be checked on your side.
